description: MainActivity.kt implements a minimalistic, modern Tic Tac Toe game with custom piece visuals, state management, UI setup, game logic, animations, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Activity managing the Tic Tac Toe game UI, game state, user input, animations, and game logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and prepares the game board.

methods.name: setupBoard
methods.description: Dynamically creates and arranges the 3x3 grid buttons for the game board.

methods.name: onCellClick
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a cell: updates model, triggers animation, checks for winner or draw, and switches turn.

methods.name: animatePiecePlacement
methods.description: Performs fade and scale animation when placing a piece.

methods.name: refreshBoardUI
methods.description: Aligns button labels and colors with the current game state; optionally with animation.

methods.name: pieceSymbol
methods.description: Returns the Unicode symbol representing a player's piece.

methods.name: updateStatusBar
methods.description: Updates the status text to reflect current turn or game outcome.

methods.name: switchPlayer
methods.description: Alternates the current player between 'X' and 'O'.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks whether all board cells are occupied, indicating a draw if no winner.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Determines whether the last move resulted in a win, checking rows, columns, and diagonals.

methods.name: highlightWinningRow
methods.description: Highlights the winning combination of cells with an accent color.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game state for a new game, preserving any overall stats or history.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets everything including stats; calls restartGame in this implementation.
